description:
Designed around the comfortable urban geometry our Skyway line is known for, this pedal assisted version is tailor made for urban adventures. If you’re looking to take the grunt work out of your cycling or just arrive at the office without wanting a shower, the Skyway e bike could be your next ride. Built on a light and strong aluminum frame that’s perfectly paired with an efficient Bafang drive unit, this bike has five different modes to give your pedalling a helping hand — from Eco’s subtle “wind at your back” feeling to the hill levelling power of Boost. Shimano’s Cues drivetrain offers proven performance and can stand up to the extra torque from an e bike. Hydraulic disc brakes keep your e assisted speed right where you want it, offering a ton of stopping power — even on rainy days. Fully kitted out with lights, fenders, and a rack, this hybrid e bike makes your commute a little easier and a lot more enjoyable.

Lower top tube makes mounting and dismounting easier

Frame uses 6000 series butted aluminum tubing, giving it an excellent strength to weight ratio.

Bafang M-210 drive unit has 250W of power, up to 80Nm of torque, and provides smooth pedalling assistance up to 32km/h

Bar mounted computer and controller cycles through modes, turns on lights, and gives information about your bike

5 modes to help you balance assist-level and range: Eco, tour, Sport, Sport+, and Boost

Computer is Bluetooth™ compatible for use with fitness sensors.

504WH battery lithium-ion battery provides up to lots of range and is locked in the frame

Removable battery lets you have more than one battery, great for long days in the saddle.

Battery can be charged on or off the bike

Distance on a charge varies based on ride conditions, things like: assistance level, wind, hills, road surface, frequency of starting and stopping, etc. all impact range, expect somewhere between 25 and 150km

To keep your battery performing at its best, follow the manufacturer’s guidelines regarding storage and charging conditions (e-Bike batteries can be very sensitive to cold temperatures)

SR Suntour front suspension fork with lockout, smooths out the bumps in the road.

Shimano MT201 hydraulic disc brakes provide outstanding stopping power in all weather conditions

9-speed Shimano Cues drivetrain provides smooth, reliable shifting, and gearing to compliment the Bafang drive unit

The Cues line provides reliable performance, durability, and easy maintenance – with cross compatibility across the line

Upright seated position and 25mm riser bars give you good visibility in traffic

Composite flat pedals are easy to use in a wide rang of footwear, from business casual to flip-flops

Maxxis Metropass 27.5 x 2in. tires have directional lugs that balance grip and speed, use a 4-season rubber compound with 3mm of puncture protection, and are certified for use with e-bikes up to 50kph.

Integrated front and rear lights help you see and be seen.

Kickstand means you always have a parking spot for your new e-bike

Fenders and chain cover help keep you dry on those wet weather commutes

Bikes are covered by MEC's Rocksolid Guarantee and Bike Service Agreement. You can bring your bike to any MEC bike shop for free adjustments and minor maintenance for a year after purchase

MEC bikes are designed in Canada. Everything from the frames to the graphics were developed at the MEC Head Office in Vancouver, BC

Due to challenges with supply chain, components may be substituted for comparable parts at any time. The listed build is how MEC intended your bike to arrive, though the manufacturer may need to make a tweak or two to get you riding sooner
